title: Deprecation lifecycle: price legend, compatibility cards, and locale-aware screenshots for release notes
creator: Aisha Karim
description:
Purpose: Produce a compact and shareable set of screenshots and micro-visuals for the release notes and onboarding quickstart that explain: (1) new model entries in the catalog, (2) deprecation timeline and user impact, and (3) price-tier legend and regional price overlays. These visuals will be used in: release notes, product changelog, quickstart onboarding modal, and press pack.

Scope: create 7 deliverables: hero screenshot (catalog entry for new model with price ribbon), compact deprecation timeline card (with sunset + migration CTA), three locale-aware pricing overlays (USD/EUR/JPY), compatibility matrix micro-card (shows model -> recommended model variants and quantization compatibility), compact tooltip for prorated billing note, and an annotated Figma file with export-ready 2x/3x PNGs and SVGs for doc authors.

Design goals: clarity at small sizes (280–680px widths), minimize copy, accessible color contrast for price badges and deprecation ribbons, and consistent alignment with console typography tokens. Emphasize minimal friction for customers migrating from deprecated models (clear CTA + suggested model).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Hero catalog screenshot with price ribbon present and localized currency label for USD, EUR, JPY; 2) Deprecation timeline card that shows: announcement date, sunset date, recommended replacement model, and migration CTA; 3) Compatibility micro-card showing model family, quantization compatibility (8-bit/4-bit), and latency tier; 4) Proration tooltip copy with legal-safe language approved by PM; 5) All assets exported at 1x/2x/3x PNG and vector SVG and added to Drive; 6) Figma file includes component variants and naming consistent with design system; 7) PM and ENG review comments incorporated and screenshots uploaded to the release notes draft in Drive.
